text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару now faces the Kinko
Sho,
where Сайленс Судзука will be
competing as well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Puffed up with pride,
Matikanefukukitaru
declares how much
she's changed compared to
last year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука is concerned by her
strange
mannerisms and how she seems
to believe that
her luck is infallible.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With a strange glint in her eye, she
heads to the
track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
